fusions.name: Bodkin Shot
fusions.desc: Looses a narrow bodkin shaft that deals 30 damage and ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Full-Draw Finish
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: a shot that deals 18 damage, up to 1.4 times as much at 5 tiles, and leaves it [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Arrow Post
fusions.desc: Plants a fortified arrow post that shoots enemies within 5 tiles for 6 damage every 1.5 seconds, for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Return Fire
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything but fire, your next strike has 20% more critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
